Export the study's analyses as CDISC ARS

Source: R/study.R
export_ars.Rd

Writes the study's ARD definition – with its table and report definitions: levels, titles, footnotes, files – as a CDISC Analysis Results Standard reporting event (tflspec::tfl_ars()): the ARS JSON (the form to exchange), CDISC's Excel template of it (to read), and ars_check.csv, what tflspec::tfl_check_ars() finds and what the ARS does not say (tflspec::tfl_ars_unmapped()). An analysis needs its purpose (a column of the ARD definition's analyses) for the ARS to be complete; a blank one is listed.

Usage

export_ars(study, dir, profile = c("cdisc", "siera"))

Arguments

study

An rtfstudy.

dir

Destination folder.

profile

"cdisc", or "siera" for a reporting event siera can run (see tflspec::tfl_ars()).

Value

The paths written, invisibly.
